units.source_text: 庭中景色艳丽优美，难怪平日间贵公子们相邀前来时，都流连不忍离去。

en.t: The garden scenery was splendid and beautiful, so it was no wonder that when noble young gentlemen invited one another to come here in ordinary times, they lingered and could hardly bear to leave.

units.source_text: 这两个愁绪万斛的恋人之间的娓娓情话，笔墨不能描写。

en.t: No brush or ink could describe the tender, lingering words exchanged between these two lovers burdened with immeasurable sorrow.

units.source_text: 渐次明亮起来的天色，仿佛特为此情景添加背景。

en.t: The sky, gradually growing brighter, seemed as though it had come especially to add a backdrop to this scene.
